items.title: ‘Egglets – The Long 10 Days’ has you managing a crisis
items.en_title: ‘Egglets – The Long 10 Days’ has you managing a crisis
items.en_oneliner: Egglets - The Long 10 Days puts you in charge of a small town amid global upheaval, making choices in a crisis, and the review discusses the trade-offs of this management sim.

items.title: Camera 101: How to choose your game’s perspective
items.en_title: Camera 101: How to choose your game’s perspective
items.en_oneliner: Unity's official camera primer compares top-down, side-scrolling, first-person, and other common perspectives, helping developers pick the right presentation for their game.

items.title: How Soft Crunch Games built Foxy Dumplings for every platform
items.en_title: How Soft Crunch Games built Foxy Dumplings for every platform
items.en_oneliner: Soft Crunch Games shares how one Unity project brought Foxy Dumplings to PC, console, and mobile, covering input abstraction and cloud saves.
